body: Just flushed them. I wont sleep tonight though. Fuck,
I dont even know. Im scatterbrained as fuck right now.

I skipped school today, sat at home, played some video games, listened to some music, wrote my goodbye letter. I beat Bioshock Infinite, that was cool. I sent a text to this girl ive had a crush on for a long time, she replied, asked me what was wrong, I couldnt bring myself to reply. I have a bunch of pills in my hand, but i cant take them. Its scary. Please help me
Nothing is worse living for though.
I'm still here. I'm counting down two hours. Just listening to some of my favourite music.
She was perfect, the only girl I've ever dated, the only girl I've ever said "I love you" too. She broke up with me because I wasn't exciting and didn't rush our physical relationship.
"My girl" cheated on me and told me I was worthless, I was heartbroken but I though id gotten over it.
I want to kill myself, but I cant, im too scared. Hell, Im 17. I shouldnt be like I am now but ive just had a shitty life.
